matches.note: An over-the-top-rope battle royal for the vacant GNW North American Championship, also billed as a qualifier for an EWWF-wide inter-federation tournament. Wolverine won; the promotion's own broadcast script names roughly a dozen further entrants (Playboy Shawn Shanoski, Pain, Chris Malenko, Sensational Shawn Stevens, Scotty "The Body" Richards, Lazarus, Nick "The Greek Nightmare" Lampidis, Ryan "The Premium" Scottsdale, Azrael, Lucifer "Satan" Diablo, Pyro, Inferno, Leon "Purple" Hayze) whose eliminations are not individually resolved in the source and are not minted.
